trigger: candidate shows model, midpoint, broker, fair-value, day-one, credit/funding or new-flow profit
action: reconcile displayed PnL to cash and quantity-aware exit value; separately attribute trading edge, institutional subsidy, model parameter mark, counterparty credit and future hedge/roll/funding reserves
risk_guard: unrealized model parameter differences, unowned credit subsidy, new-flow masking or omitted lifetime hedge cost cannot approve entry or count as realized alpha

trigger: any simulated or live order policy is evaluated
action: save decision, quote, pre-trade, fill and multiple post-trade snapshots with common-factor/hedge benchmarks; compare aggressive, passive, partial-fill and nonfill branches
risk_guard: do not infer causal informed trading from an adverse move; do not report spread capture without post-fill markout and inventory hedge P/L

trigger: an American binary model, source example, vendor value or backtest is calibrated or reproduced
action: store calendar_time, business_time, variance_time, day-count, monitoring grid, payment timing, model family and signed position; run 365/252 and continuous/discrete regression branches; quarantine the source 51%/54.…
risk_guard: unrecorded clocks or owner/writer signs can reverse Greeks and materially change hit probability; source examples are not production golden values

trigger: candidate has locked or convergent terminal payoff, legs at different accounts/venues, daily VM, collateral haircuts, funding calls or unsettled positive MTM
action: simulate ordered cashflows by account, venue, leg, time and scenario; include gross eligible collateral, stress haircut, VM, funding, fees, transfer delay and forced-liquidation feedback
risk_guard: reject when any account path has negative available liquidity; positive MTM elsewhere counts only after proven immediate transfer or cross-collateralization; post-liquidation convergence is unavailable

trigger: candidate has common relative-value legs, shared borrow/funding, crowded hedge proxies, dealer concentration or convergence dependent on weak-holder survival
action: stress continued spread widening, borrow recall, correlation/settlement-basis break, haircut increase, transfer delay, limit reduction, peer forced unwind and disappearance of new flow
risk_guard: expected convergence, low historical basis variance or net portfolio neutrality cannot approve the trade if the account fails any crowding branch

trigger: candidate depends on future convergence, expiry, barrier, exercise, assignment, stop, forced liquidation or discretionary exit
action: report weighted contract duration only for comparable path-independent legs; additionally estimate first-exit distribution, latest expiry, funding commitment horizon, peak-capital time and high-quantile holding time
risk_guard: a weighted-average expiry cannot approve path-dependent exposure or capital sufficiency; block if amount units or stopping events are unresolved

trigger: candidate, report, alert or strategy name uses arbitrage, convergence, risk-free, locked profit or equivalent wording
action: assign exactly one label academic_no_arb_candidate/mechanical_relative_value/statistical_relative_value/passive_switch_only/marketing_only and retain the relation order plus feasibility evidence
risk_guard: positive expectation, initial credit, historical correlation or theoretical convergence cannot receive a risk-free label; unknown relation type forces WATCH_ONLY

trigger: early/late extrema timing or record-event frequency supports a signal, roll or simulation
action: populate ExtremumTimingSpec with process, measure, clock, monitoring, drift/jumps and uncertainty; use arcsine only for driftless continuous-Brownian regression
risk_guard: argmax time is not extremum magnitude, market probability or risk-neutral price

trigger: a payoff references an average price, multiple fixings or floating average strike
action: populate AsianFixingSpec; normalize weights, persist official past fixings and accumulated state, and separate arithmetic/geometric plus fixed/floating strike
risk_guard: source product-of-weights normalization, missing/duplicate fixes and current-spot-only valuation are rejected

trigger: an Asian or average-price proxy is priced or risk-managed
action: route geometric GBM baseline separately from arithmetic MC/PDE/approximation; build full forward/vol/covariance buckets and report approximation/midpoint residual
risk_guard: fixing levels are correlated and a 30-percent vol threshold does not choose the model

trigger: an arithmetic-average FX/crypto quote is inverted or converted to another numeraire
action: apply pathwise Jensen/contract-identity check; price the stated quote and fixing average directly, with currency and settlement metadata
risk_guard: 1/average(X) is not average(1/X); reciprocal conversion cannot silently change the payoff

trigger: a vanilla hedge uses 1/sqrt(3) or 1.73 for an Asian exposure
action: label literature proxy; recompute schedule-specific covariance and local Gamma ratio, then full-revalue residual across spot/time/fixings/surface
risk_guard: variance ratio is 1/3, standard deviation ratio is 1/sqrt(3), and local Gamma neutrality is not global skew neutrality

trigger: a barrier or conditional payoff is determined by official settlement, auction, fixing window or another discrete published value
action: populate AtSettlementBarrierSpec with observation days, intraday and official sources, publication/revision policy, crossings/time-above, pre-settlement hedge, post-settlement unwind, overnight gap and dispute state;…
risk_guard: intraday crossing does not necessarily trigger payment, while settlement revision or overnight gap can change the legal state after the trading hedge moved

trigger: a direct or embedded payoff changes after a price barrier is first validly observed
action: populate BarrierContractSpec with in/out, direction, regular/reverse, underlying payoff, monitoring, rebate, payment and post-trigger instrument; unresolved fields set CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED
risk_guard: product names do not define path events; legal monitoring and settlement override continuous-model assumptions

trigger: point-in-time open interest, dealer-position evidence or visible stops suggest barrier clustering near a level
action: populate BarrierCrowdingState and test OOS relation to depth loss, overshoot, spread and impact; keep multiplier at 1 without preregistered evidence
risk_guard: rumor, narrow recent range or a chart cannot generate magnet/mean-reversion orders

trigger: a future-date payoff, PnL, Greek or barrier-risk chart is used to justify a trade or hedge
action: populate GraphComparisonSpec with initial hedge state, valuation time, same-path flag, recenter/rehedge flags, hedge cash flows, trigger state, surface/carry and costs/margin;…
risk_guard: different delta-neutral origins or recentered slices cannot be read as realized time PnL; static charts omit execution history

trigger: a fixed-expiry, continuous-payoff or linear-Greek instrument is proposed to hedge a discontinuous or randomly terminating exposure
action: populate BarrierHedgeMatchSpec and compare target versus hedge on value, Delta, Gamma, Vega, Volga, Vanna, gap delta, full first-exit distribution and post-trigger residue across spot-time-surface-trigger grids;…
risk_guard: matching one Greek at inception cannot authorize the hedge; a hedge passes only when the full risk distribution improves within account liquidity constraints

trigger: a barrier or threshold position has hedge inventory that must change at trigger
action: produce OFF/no-unwind, ON/perfect-unwind and GAP/executable-unwind reports plus pre-trigger-stop bounce; preserve audited snapshot, units and discontinuity flags
risk_guard: perfect STOP ON cannot substitute for gap/partial-fill risk and OFF cannot represent the intended post-trigger state

trigger: fixed-maturity vanilla, forward or Vega legs hedge a random-duration barrier exposure
action: build BarrierTermStructureHedgeSpec; scatter hedges across first-exit buckets and optimize residual, depth, costs and tail loss; keep single-vol expected-time hedge as baseline only
risk_guard: one expected maturity hides distribution and can force costly repeated maturity extension

trigger: a barrier, one-touch, rebate or bounded event claim is called long Vega, Vega-neutral, cheap volatility or higher-moment exposure
action: populate VolatilityCurvatureState; report signed Vega, Volga, Vanna, surface bump rule, face ceiling and high/low-vol full-revaluation PnL; preserve fourth/sixth moment only as source aliases unless a formal moment mapping is supplied
risk_guard: zero local Vega is not zero volatility risk; bounded target upside can coexist with unbounded or much larger hedge-leg losses

trigger: a linear basket/spread is priced or hedged as a single vanilla at net volatility
action: populate BasketVolSpec and PseudovanillaSpec; compare full model across spot/surface/correlation/jump states and reject relative vol near B=0
risk_guard: linear sums are generally nonlognormal and proxy corr vega only matches selected local risk

trigger: an interval digital, betspread, accordion, density bucket or higher-moment event structure is quoted, inferred or scanned
action: populate IntervalDigitalSpec with ordered boundaries, open/closed endpoints, payoff, component digitals, executable quotes, surface source, probability mass, no-arbitrage price bounds and neighboring-bucket reconciliation;…
risk_guard: a nonnegative interval payoff cannot have a negative frictionless price; higher-moment exposure does not establish alpha, and sparse/noisy strike differentiation can manufacture false probability mass

trigger: a listed, OTC, synthetic, event, prediction-market or embedded binary payoff enters the candidate universe
action: populate BinaryContractSpec with payoff amount and currency, underlying observation, European/American/path type, strict/inclusive event, official fixing source and timestamp, exercise/assignment, settlement latency, multiplier, venue and d…
risk_guard: binary labels and broker symbology cannot determine the equality event or fixing; unresolved boundaries, observation source, payoff currency or cancellation rules set CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED and block ranking

trigger: a binary price, N(d1), N(d2), option delta or surface derivative is described as probability, odds, forecast, confidence or expected return
action: populate ProbabilityMeasureSpec with measure role Q/P/subjective/stress, numeraire, discounting, event, horizon, estimator, calibration window, uncertainty and conversion assumptions;…
risk_guard: discounted risk-neutral event price is not a physical forecast; vanilla delta is not a universal exercise probability; changing numeraire or payoff units changes the probability-like representation

trigger: time-to-expiry shrinks, spot approaches a binary strike/fixing boundary, or a discontinuous payoff is dynamically hedged or rolled
action: populate PinRiskState with distance in spot/vol units and ticks, time, fixing window, maximum Delta/Gamma/Vega/turnover, jump scenarios crossing and recrossing the boundary, market depth, halt/auction risk, hedge budget, assignment/settleme…
risk_guard: bounded terminal payoff does not imply bounded replication loss; theoretical Delta concentration and Dirac limits do not guarantee executable hedges;…

trigger: a binary is inferred from an option chain, replicated by vertical spreads, or used as a probability-density/surface feature
action: populate BinaryReplicationSpec with strike spacing h, boundary orientation, A/h quantities, executable bid/ask depth, legging path, fees, margin, discrete-grid error, surface-regularization method and jump/pin residual;…
risk_guard: the h-to-zero mathematical limit is not an execution plan; reject missing-minus-sign derivatives, nonconvex call surfaces, quantities beyond depth/capacity and replication whose cost or residual exceeds its claimed edge

trigger: one or more binary/event claims are sized, diversified, warehoused, replicated or aggregated into the barbell portfolio
action: populate BinaryRiskModeSpec with statistical-hold-to-settlement versus replication/dynamic-hedge mode, per-claim loss bound, gross payout, common-event map, covariance/tail-dependence model, concentration, hedge turnover, margin and account…
risk_guard: bounded individual claims are not automatically diversified, convex or positive expectancy; shared market crashes, issuer/fixing events and hedge-liquidity shocks can synchronize losses

trigger: binary fair value, strike probability, density, skew trade or surface-derived signal is calculated
action: fit a no-arbitrage call-price surface using declared quote side, timestamp, carry and regularization; compute both fixed-vol partial and total strike derivative, quantify the skew term and publish interpolation/extrapolation uncertainty
risk_guard: flat-vol N(d2), raw finite differences, the source's printed numerical values and charts outside nonnegative payoff bounds cannot enter production truth;…

trigger: candidate contains two or more expiries or a roll replacement changes expiry
action: retain per-expiry forward, delta, gamma, vega, surface, basis, funding/borrow, settlement, liquidity and account buckets before any aggregation
risk_guard: aggregate net Greeks cannot pass when a material expiry bucket, curve slope/curvature or settlement branch remains exposed

trigger: candidate has positive carry, initial credit, smooth Sharpe or short-front/short-vol exposure
action: stress joint skew, volatility jump, borrow/funding, correlation, liquidity, margin and repeated-exposure regimes; compare carry earned with tail loss and survival time
risk_guard: positive carry or historical Sharpe cannot approve leverage, short tail or calendar convergence

trigger: a barrier, double-barrier, stopping-time, compound or numerical-integration formula is considered for implementation
action: populate ClosedFormAudit and require symbol/domain, dimension, boundary, parity, limit, convergence, payoff-weighted truncation, Monte Carlo and PDE checks before production approval
risk_guard: physical PDF 480-488 formulas and fixed integration/series cutoffs are audit evidence, not trusted code specifications

trigger: a volatility, return, volume, liquidation or order-flow cluster is claimed as a regime or alpha signal
action: predeclare null and alternative, compare observed cluster statistic to point-in-time null/holdout and report economic effect after costs
risk_guard: random sequences contain streaks and clusters; visual regularity is not evidence by itself

trigger: a manager, strategy, parameter set, venue, asset or candidate is evaluated because it has a strong historical record
action: report original point-in-time cohort, entry/exit and selection rule, raw/effective candidate count, dispersion, all failures and selected-winner distribution
risk_guard: the distribution of the maximum may not be presented as the unconditional distribution of a prespecified strategy

trigger: any option strategy is simulated, ranked, rolled or claimed to survive until expiry or a tail event
action: build per-account lower, margin, liquidity and venue/custody boundaries; compare ruin, edge, stop and expiry as competing first events using less-than-or-equal lower-barrier logic
risk_guard: terminal payoff is unavailable after an earlier absorbing liquidation; source greater-than stopping sign is a failure fixture

trigger: candidate described as option-on-option or higher-dimensional option
action: classify as direct listed/OTC compound, vanilla dynamic replication, or risk-report-only synthetic exposure
risk_guard: never treat these three as fungible without executable quote and replication-error model

trigger: an expiry or P/L chart for a path-dependent structure conditions on no prior trigger
action: label the conditioning event and show survival mass, trigger branch, unconditional path distribution, funding, repeated attempts and total wealth
risk_guard: conditional survival profiles cannot enter ranking alone; zero debit is not a risk classification

trigger: an option premium, fee, loan, rebate or financing obligation is paid only when an exercise/event condition occurs
action: populate ContingentPremiumSpec with the payment event, amount, timing, credit/funding/collateral terms, vanilla and digital components, no-upfront valuation identity, terminal break-evens and executable alternatives;…
risk_guard: zero upfront cash is not free optionality or limited economic loss; the event-contingent liability, funding burden and counterparty dependence remain part of payoff and margin

trigger: ingest any contract, multi-leg candidate or roll replacement
action: materialize time profile, decomposition, payoff continuity, barrier, state variables, hedge proxy, option order, path memory and exercise/settlement fields; version every regime transition
risk_guard: return CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED and block automatic ranking when a material field or event branch is unknown

trigger: entry, hold or roll rationale uses carry, convergence, roll-down or theta
action: reconcile full-revaluation P/L and separately report explicit carry, curve roll-down, option decay, spot/basis, curve/surface, funding, fees, slippage and residual under a versioned attribution order
risk_guard: do not assign option decay, source unit-incomplete formula or unexplained residual to carry/alpha

trigger: cross-asset diversification, correlation trade, basket proxy, pair-vol triangle or joint path is evaluated
action: build CorrelationGeometry for common measure/numeraire/horizon; verify triangle and PSD, disclose repair distance and rerun ranking under bid-ask feasible and stress matrices
risk_guard: individually valid correlations do not guarantee a joint process; source missing-half and duplicated labels are failure fixtures

trigger: a multiasset model or stress uses pairwise correlations
action: validate symmetry, diagonal and eigenvalues; store raw/repaired matrices, repair distance and only PSD-feasible shocks
risk_guard: pairwise values within [-1,1] are insufficient in n dimensions and matrix repair cannot hide data defects

trigger: candidate uses cross-asset hedge, proxy, dispersion, basket, implied correlation, basis, regression or correlation stress
action: save rho, both directional betas, residual, units, synchronization, estimator/window/weights, uncertainty, regime, stress matrices and parameter drift
risk_guard: rho cannot be used as hedge quantity; constant or historical correlation cannot remove residual or stress branches; printed weighted cross-moment is not correlation

trigger: portfolio aggregation across Schwab, IBKR, OKX, Binance or another venue
action: show both total wealth and each account/legal-entity liquidation state; mark nontransferable or delayed funds
risk_guard: one account may not rely on another account balance unless transfer mechanics pass the same stress path

trigger: the payoff asset and barrier observation asset differ
action: populate CrossAssetBarrierSpec; compute both deltas, cross-Gamma, correlation/tail dependence, venue clocks, basis/FX/numeraire and joint gap
risk_guard: a single correlation number or independence assumption cannot remove cross-market execution and common-jump risk

trigger: two or more liquid expiry buckets with consistent surface snapshots
action: enumerate long-back/short-front wing or calendar candidates and compute raw, bucketed and modified vega separately
risk_guard: 60/20/80 is literature-only; reject if pathwise short-expiry event or margin fails

trigger: candidate is described as convex, nonlinear, optional, antifragile or profitable from volatility
action: populate CurvatureState and PayoffChoiceSpec for every relevant risk factor, finite state interval, time slice, exercise right and bilateral obligation; price premium, carry and path costs separately
risk_guard: local positive Gamma, nonzero second derivative or contamination cannot establish global convexity, holder optionality or positive expected return

trigger: payoff contains a jump, digital, touch or barrier event
action: report jump size, executable replication width, trigger gap, static limited-loss branch and dynamic-replication branch
risk_guard: reject dynamic replication when hedge legs are unavailable, discontinuity loss exceeds budget, or survival relies on filling at the trigger

trigger: a structure has lower/upper barriers or pays a rebate on first termination
action: build a shared first-of-two state machine and RebateSpec; match payment time, currency, monitoring, credit and cancellation before decomposition
risk_guard: two single barriers are not independent and hit-paid is not expiry-paid

trigger: a payoff terminates or pays on first touch of either a lower or upper barrier
action: populate DoubleBarrierSDFSpec with first-of-two, pay-once-or-each, touch-low/high/both events, intersection value, payment time, termination state and nonadditivity residual;…
risk_guard: two single touches can double-pay both-touch paths and are not a statewise substitute; price-to-face does not identify expected life

trigger: candidate thesis relies on dynamic hedging, terminal insurance, resale, flow, customer demand or market-making economics
action: declare whether each account instance is a terminal-value user, dynamic hedger, reseller/flow trader or market maker; attach the corresponding P/L decomposition, permissions, costs, inventory limits and exit assumptions
risk_guard: economics and evidence from one role cannot be transferred to another; model value, terminal value, dynamic-hedge P/L and resale value remain separate

trigger: every multi-leg candidate and every roll comparison
action: materialize future-time by spot or standardized-moneyness by surface-state tensors with expired and exercised legs processed
risk_guard: a static bucket or current net Greek cannot pass the strategy gate without the dynamic tensor

trigger: a note, coupon, principal, rebate, knock-out, credit or structured cash flow changes after a breach or first event
action: populate EmbeddedBarrierExposureSpec; map every affected cash flow, memory/reset/dwell/count, issuer/holder choices, joint termination, credit/recovery and hedgeability; use a joint state machine when independent decomposition fails
risk_guard: wrapper labels can hide gap delta and random duration; simple sums are invalid under memory, mutual termination, issuer call or shared principal feedback

trigger: ensemble, market average, survivor performance or long-run time average is used to approve a strategy
action: report unconditional ensemble wealth, survivor-conditioned mean, survival mass and single-account time metric separately; state almost-sure ruin, integrability, restart and injection conditions
risk_guard: source decreasing-sign conflict and insufficient theorem assumptions are isolated; survivor mean cannot replace total account outcome

trigger: a strategy is justified by long run, convergence, mean reversion, time diversification or waiting until the tail arrives
action: populate ErgodicityStatus for the exact object/transform and list stationarity, invariant law, dependence, absorbing states, censoring and entry/exit; default to not_tested
risk_guard: ruined, delisted, stopped or redeemed paths cannot wait for ensemble averages; arithmetic ensemble wealth cannot replace account time growth

trigger: candidate shows initial credit, model edge, midpoint profit, fair-value markup or current Greek neutrality
action: report model mark, midpoint, quantity/side-aware exit value, nonprice close cost, future-hedge reserve, funding/margin reserve and crowding state; retain future risk tensor
risk_guard: model or midpoint markup cannot be realized P/L or approve entry; block if reserve policy, exit depth or crowding branch is missing

trigger: candidate requires delta hedge or roll execution under material positive or negative Gamma
action: evaluate passive/limit and aggressive/triggered policies with queue, nonfill, adverse-selection, maker/taker, spread-widening and legging branches; show Leland values only as literature benchmarks
risk_guard: do not assume trade-through fill, spread capture or a universal order type from source lore

trigger: American/Bermudan exercise, short-option assignment, ex-dividend date, hard-to-borrow state, deep ITM state, broker auto-exercise or expiry pin can alter holdings
action: materialize ExerciseLifecycleSpec with pre-state, available choices, exercise/assignment probability or scenario, surface/carry/borrow/dividend inputs, cutoff, replacement liquidity/cost, post-state, residual synthetic wings, margin and rol…
risk_guard: exercise is an irreversible portfolio transformation, not a scalar option flag; block automated exercise recommendations when post-state legs, replacement prices or broker rules are unresolved

trigger: position or proposed roll enters an expiry, exercise, assignment or barrier window
action: branch by settlement, exercise cutoff, after-hours move, assignment, barrier and partial-fill states; compare pre/post-roll primary and secondary exposure
risk_guard: block automated roll ranking when any material contract-state branch is unresolved

trigger: strategy ideation and scanner ranking
action: rank declared payoff exposure, price and fragility rather than directional forecast confidence
risk_guard: forecast fields may annotate but cannot bypass structural gates

trigger: close-to-close, range/Parkinson or multi-horizon variance suggests a different extrema process than the pricing model
action: populate ExtremumProcessSpec; pre-register session, source, filters, horizons and overlap corrections; test point-in-time out of sample with real quotes/fills and explicit Q/P conversion
risk_guard: the source trading rules are hypotheses, not direct alpha; microstructure and bad extrema can reverse the signal

trigger: expected time to ruin, margin call, stop, edge or liquidation is reported over a finite horizon
action: include right-censored paths and state units; for the geometric fixture add K times survival mass and distinguish exposure count from calendar time
risk_guard: failed-path-only averages understate stopping time and erase surviving strategies; lambda/p without units is invalid

trigger: a barrier, first-touch or threshold strategy may terminate or rebalance before nominal expiry
action: populate StoppingTimeDistributionSpec with CDF, survival, bucket mass, truncated mean, quantiles, monitoring correction and stress distributions
risk_guard: expected exit time and terminal hit probability are insufficient statistics for maturity, liquidity and hedge risk

trigger: stop, barrier, short-gamma hedge, margin call or venue liquidation condition becomes reachable
action: simulate trigger, contingent order, partial/no fill, endogenous impact, spread/depth deterioration and margin state in one ordered path
risk_guard: trigger or stop price may never substitute for fill price; reject if an account breaches margin before executable exit

trigger: forward, future, perpetual, synthetic forward or delta hedge is substituted for another instrument
action: populate ForwardFutureBasisSpec with terminal exposure, initial notional, variation-margin clock, mark source, funding/credit/collateral cash flows, settlement, basis, cash-flow correlation and venue rules;…
risk_guard: terminal similarity or h=exp(-rt) cannot establish pathwise equivalence; the source's printed 1,269,000 notional is quarantined as a factor-of-ten anomaly

trigger: candidate compares IV with historical/forecast volatility or uses EWMA/GARCH/event information to label options cheap or expensive
action: output historical estimates, statistical forecasts, IV, scheduled-event overlay, jump scenario and variance-risk-premium hypothesis as separate versioned components; evaluate each forecast out of sample
risk_guard: past-price model cannot absorb unavailable future event information; IV is not physical expectation; author opinion about model superiority cannot approve a trade

trigger: any cross-expiry, cross-venue, calendar, diagonal, proxy or arbitrage-labelled candidate
action: materialize normal/stress delivery, settlement, borrow, funding, convertibility, collateral, netting and arbitrage-direction states for every leg
risk_guard: do not label a trade arbitrage or treat legs as fungible when a material replication field is unknown or can become unavailable under stress

trigger: spot, index, mark, settlement, IV or PnL approaches or crosses a contractual or strategy barrier
action: create GapDeltaState with valid-trigger evidence, pre/post contract delta, pre/post hedge targets, actual fills, queue/latency/depth/impact, fake-trigger, gap, recrossing, halt/auction and dispute branches;…
risk_guard: do not assume a stop fills at the barrier or that hedge inventory disappears with the claim; near-expiry turnover and margin must fit the account

trigger: a gap report multiplies delta quantity by trigger-to-fill price change
action: require price scale, multiplier, delta currency, P/L currency and FX conversion; expose source .20/.02 and 3×/4× conflicts as explicit failed fixtures
risk_guard: unitless arithmetic is rejected and source conflicts are never silently resolved into production parameters

trigger: Gaussian/Black-Scholes diffusion, sqrt-time, sigma event or CLT justification is used
action: record centering/scaling and test dependence, dominant jumps, stochastic scale, regimes and conditional versus unconditional identity; retain Gaussian only as a declared baseline
risk_guard: quincunx and infinite-toss visuals do not prove financial returns are iid Gaussian

trigger: any Monte Carlo probability, expected PnL, survival rate or path percentile is published
action: populate GeneratorPassport with process, measure, cutoff, parameters, clock, dependence, jumps/regimes, surface, liquidity, margin, venue, seed, convergence and omitted risks; reject probability publication if incomplete
risk_guard: more paths reduce sampling error only and must not downgrade model-specification risk

trigger: candidate has positive local Gamma or tail payoff
action: revalue across spot, time, surface, jump, liquidity, margin and parameter perturbations
risk_guard: reject local-convex/global-fragile candidates and parameter knife edges

trigger: tail model/stress is claimed to cover Black Swan risk or justify a long-tail trade
action: populate GrayBlackStressSpec; price/probabilize declared model ensemble separately from premise-break shocks, then apply survival and executable-price gates
risk_guard: fitted fractal only grays some events, and fat tails do not prove tail options are cheap

trigger: candidate is delta/vega neutral now or contains multiple strikes/expiries
action: compute future-time Greek migration, vega sign map and converged up/down lock delta
risk_guard: reject neutrality claims that bleed into undeclared exposure or flip sign before a registered stress boundary

trigger: a portfolio is described as Delta, Gamma, Vega, Theta, Rho or correlation neutral
action: report leg-level gross, net, direction grid, expiry buckets, surface/cross Greeks, jump/gap/trigger/liquidation residual and cancellation stability
risk_guard: a high cancellation ratio is a fragility flag, not proof that risk disappeared

trigger: profitable put leg reaches a pre-registered harvest state
action: run two separate hypotheses: H_buy buys farther OTM put; H_sell sells farther OTM put only inside a fully bounded package
risk_guard: H_sell defaults to reject if it creates unbounded or budget-breaking short left tail

trigger: a delta, vega, surface, roll or threshold rebalance frequency is proposed
action: evaluate full-path replication variance, spread/fee, impact, gap/surface loss, no-fill/outage and account margin over a frequency grid
risk_guard: never infer that more frequent rebalancing monotonically lowers executable risk

trigger: a barrier hedge is Delta-, Vega- or Greek-neutral at the current state
action: full-revalue claim plus hedge over trigger-state×spot×time×surface×carry×liquidity×legal grids; compare tail loss, margin and execution before and after
risk_guard: current neutrality and local convexity cannot be called global protection; the source single hedge is not a universal ban

trigger: a composite payoff has untradeable factors, basis, credit or convertibility risk
action: populate CompositeUnderlyingSpec; label pricing measure/criterion or output value range; model baseline option and credit/convertibility joint cashflows
risk_guard: physical discounted expectation is not automatically unique no-arbitrage value and default cannot be scalar-subtracted

trigger: KI, KO and vanilla quotes or model values are compared
action: build InOutParitySpec and require every contract field to match; add rebate/early-payment American-binary legs before reconciliation
risk_guard: statewise payoff parity is not executable PnL parity and fails under term mismatch

trigger: a joint probability/correlation/volatility map supports price, forecast or stress
action: populate JointMeasureSurfaceSpec with Q/P/subjective/stress, horizon, sampling, PSD matrix, regimes, common jumps/default and uncertainty
risk_guard: daily physical correlation cannot fill a one-year pricing map and sqrt-time is only a baseline

trigger: a lookback is approximated with ladder or knock-in strips
action: populate LadderReplicationSpec with grid, truncation, monitoring, canonical side/quantity, statewise error, barrier surface, quotes and legging
risk_guard: epsilon-to-zero is a model limit; Short -1 is rejected and unavailable KI legs cannot become orders

trigger: contract is wrapped, structured, OTC-like, restricted, issuer-dependent, nonstandard or contains embedded options
action: populate LegalExitProfile with account permission, jurisdiction, wrapper, embedded options, holder decomposability, independent exit venues, sole market maker, early termination and counterparty dependency
risk_guard: any unknown permission, legality, decomposability or exit field forces WATCH_ONLY; theoretical component value cannot replace a legally executable holder exit

trigger: candidate sizing, rebalance and exit
action: price each leg on executable side; measure side-aware entry/rebalance/exit slippage; model spread expansion, depth loss, partial fills, one-way exit liquidity and legging risk; compute marginal close cost
risk_guard: reject size where exit cost accelerates beyond budget, required leg cannot be closed under stress, or profitability depends on favorable accumulation marks

trigger: a path-dependent barrier is priced or risked on a strike/term surface
action: calibrate LocalVolCalibrationSpec after static-arbitrage cleaning; compare flat, single-vol, local-vol and jump/stochastic stress outputs for price, Greeks, hit CDF, turnover and calibration residual
risk_guard: a single implied volatility is a baseline, not a path-process model; local vol also requires convergence and parameter stress

trigger: a contract or strategy payoff references the best/worst price, running high/low or buy-low/sell-high right
action: populate LookbackContractSpec and LookbackRiskState with exact payoff, monitoring, observation source, running extreme and settlement
risk_guard: current spot and strategy name do not identify a path-dependent contract; twice-vanilla is not a bound

trigger: recent highs/lows are labeled driftwood, magnet, mined or bad-gamma levels
action: populate BarrierCrowdingState; keep multiplier=1 until point-in-time position, depth, impact and out-of-sample evidence pass
risk_guard: historical trader language cannot generate a directional or trigger-level order

trigger: lookback/record-roll exposure is locally hedged with vanilla
action: full-revalue on spot x running-extreme x time x surface x jump grid; report Gamma, Vanna, Volga, moving-strike and execution residual separately
risk_guard: one local Greek match and the label third moment do not prove a global hedge

trigger: a new running low/high or record event causes a strike roll
action: build PathRollReplicationSpec; record event, pre/intermediate/post legs, side-aware fills, costs, funding, margin, turnover and residual
risk_guard: model strike bonus or stochastic-integral language cannot replace a discrete self-financing ledger

trigger: probability, expectation, event likelihood, fair value, Greek or strategy win rate is reported
action: attach MeasurePassport and separate P, Q, subjective and stress; require Q forward consistency and prohibit Q state price from filling P win-probability fields
risk_guard: risk-neutral weights are not physical frequencies; stress scenarios do not receive invented probabilities

trigger: two or more contracts, instruments or underlyings are joined by replication, parity, basis, regression, correlation or proxy reasoning
action: materialize RelationshipSpec; prove contract-level payoff identity for mechanical relations, otherwise classify as behavioral and retain calibration, residual, out-of-sample and break scenarios
risk_guard: any empirical coefficient, rolling correlation or historical hedge ratio forces statistical_relative_value; a payment identity still requires current execution, settlement, funding and counterparty checks

trigger: a jump, stochastic-volatility, local-volatility, surface-dynamics, rate or correlation challenger adds parameters
action: compare identifiability, calibration stability, frozen-holdout score, hedge/stress residual, executable PnL, latency and governance cost against the baseline
risk_guard: complexity and in-sample fit do not expand approved use without stable out-of-sample or execution improvement

trigger: pricing, volatility comparison or scenario generation assumes lognormal, normal/absolute, shifted or mixed dynamics
action: populate VolatilityUnitProfile with price domain, quote/tick unit, return unit, level bucket, boundary behavior, candidate process and alternative stress models
risk_guard: log returns are invalid at zero/negative prices; one historical fit cannot suppress alternative unit families; model selection cannot change ex post after losses

trigger: mean, variance, standard deviation, Pearson correlation, Sharpe or a higher-moment exposure is computed
action: populate MomentExistenceSpec for the model and required payoff order; report finite/infinite/unknown, effective sample, regime stability and alternative dependence metrics
risk_guard: non-Gaussian does not automatically mean no variance, while finite model variance does not prove stable estimation

trigger: a payoff depends on either, both, worst, best or another Boolean combination of events on multiple assets, venues or accounts
action: populate MultiassetBinarySpec with event algebra, observation clocks, assets, currencies, numeraires, joint distribution/copula or scenario engine, intersection probabilities, tail dependence, venue/fixing basis, executable hedge set and co…
risk_guard: marginal probabilities and ordinary correlation are insufficient for joint digital valuation; asynchronous fixing, crisis dependence and venue failure can dominate the apparent diversification

trigger: a report shows partial, correlated, total Delta or Gamma for multiple assets
action: separate coordinate gradient, Hessian, factor loadings/sensitivities and delta-linear variance with unit metadata
risk_guard: nabla-transpose-covariance-nabla is variance, not delta; correlation is not a deterministic move

trigger: a payoff references more than one asset, strike, choice, weight, product, ratio or currency
action: populate MultiassetPayoffSpec with payoff algebra, clocks, numeraires, settlement, credit and executable contract; apply statewise bounds
risk_guard: product labels do not define joint payoff and unavailable exotics cannot generate orders

trigger: legs on different assets or venues roll asynchronously
action: recompute weights, gradient, Hessian, corr vegas, PSD matrices, concentration, margin and liquidation in pre/intermediate/post states
risk_guard: per-leg roll reports cannot capture temporary joint factor and account exposure

trigger: source Ch.22 numeric examples are used as fixtures
action: recompute basket vol and forward units; retain 1.00/1.19, 10.28/10.29 and .225%/.225 conflicts as explicit failures
risk_guard: never silently choose an intended source number or use historical values as calibrated parameters

trigger: any threshold, feature, window, asset, expiry, moneyness, model, seed, hedge or exit rule is searched or modified
action: create immutable trial IDs, retain the full search tree, distinguish specified from any relationship, freeze holdout and preregister dependence-aware post-selection method
risk_guard: a 1.83-to-1.2 threshold change is a new trial; viewed holdout becomes training data

trigger: compound, chooser, option-on-option, deferred choice or mother/daughter terminology appears
action: create canonical outer decision and inner claim contracts with t1<t2, strikes, styles, settlement and surface/curve buckets; require outer discount and lifecycle state machine
risk_guard: source mother/daughter labels and omitted time factors cannot determine executable legs or value

trigger: no candidate passes every hard gate
action: return NO_TRADE with failed gates and evidence gaps
risk_guard: ranking engine cannot force a positive recommendation

trigger: any label containing no-loss, guaranteed, antifragile or both-tails-profit
action: require continuous state grid, path simulation, cost and margin proof; otherwise replace label with unverified claim
risk_guard: no candidate may be marketed or auto-approved as guaranteed

trigger: vol-of-vol, corr-of-corr, rolling volatility/correlation, parameter drift or any statistic of an overlapping rolling statistic is estimated
action: save overlap ratio and nominal/effective sample size; provide nonoverlapping estimate or dependence-robust inference using block bootstrap/HAC; compare multiple windows without winner-only selection
risk_guard: overlapping points cannot be counted as independent evidence; shortest interval cannot bypass microstructure and bad-data gates

trigger: a trial, scan, order attempt, model comparison or replication is negative, insignificant, missing, stopped or unpublished
action: retain outcome and selection state; label absence_of_evidence, evidence_of_absence and missing_due_to_selection separately
risk_guard: silent deletion inflates observed edge and turns missing evidence into a false negative conclusion

trigger: a quote is inverted, collateral/payoff currency changes, or positions across USD, coin and stablecoin accounts are combined
action: populate NumeraireContractSpec; transform strike, notional, discount, payoff currency and delta convention; recompute per-account cash and liquidation wealth
risk_guard: price reciprocal does not imply PnL or expectation reciprocal; arithmetic averages and fixed-cash digitals cannot be silently inverted

trigger: scanner, risk engine, strategy state machine or human alerts choose a sampling/decision frequency
action: store risk calculation, strategy decision, human notification and signal horizon separately; reproduce the source Gaussian fixture but recalibrate real-market processes
risk_guard: notification throttling may not throttle barrier, margin, liquidation or outage detection; source 19-to-1 is excluded

trigger: diversification, many legs/accounts/venues or subexponential tail is claimed to reduce aggregate tail loss
action: report max-event contribution, leave-one-event-out and single-underlying/venue/expiry/gap stresses; verify iid, fixed-n, nonnegative transform and asymptotic threshold before using one-big-jump approximation
risk_guard: more components do not guarantee tail diversification; common jumps, random n, dynamic sizing, dependence and liquidation feedback require full simulation

trigger: vega convexity, correlation convexity, higher-order Greek or more-convex-is-better is used to rank a candidate
action: populate ParameterConvexityReport, match value and first-order risks, declare parameter dynamics/measure/risk premium, full-revalue state grid and deduct execution/funding/margin
risk_guard: parameter curvature is not statewise payoff dominance and does not by itself prove underpricing or positive expectation

trigger: relative-value candidate relies on replacing an already owned asset, avoiding borrow/repo, preserving tax basis or exploiting an account-specific mandate
action: compute separate active_entry and passive_switch economics; populate endowment state from the actual account inventory, tax/funding assumptions and permissions
risk_guard: passive advantage cannot be shown as executable for an account without the required endowment; institution-specific funding or tax value is not portable alpha

trigger: lookback, ladder or Asian appears in candidate generation
action: require real instrument ID, permissions, legal terms, two-sided quotes, depth and settlement or a separately executable vanilla replication before WATCH/SIM_PASS; otherwise [local material omitted]
risk_guard: the existence of a textbook payoff does not imply Schwab, IBKR, OKX, Binance or another venue offers it

trigger: candidate uses put-call parity, synthetic stock/forward, conversion, reversal, mirror position or call/put substitution
action: populate ParityIdentitySpec with exact legs, weights, strikes, expiry, style, settlement, numeraire, multiplier, discount/dividend/borrow curves, quote times and executable bid/ask;…
risk_guard: terminal payoff equality cannot suppress early exercise, pin/assignment, funding, borrow, dividend, settlement, margin, spread or source-anomaly branches

trigger: a candidate claims bounded loss, convexity, tail profit, diversification or finite moments
action: populate PayoffTailOrderSpec separately for left/right terminal payoff and account path; prove asymptotic cancellations and compare analytic beta with far-grid full revaluation
risk_guard: option product names and limited premium do not capture dynamic margin, short financing, liquidation or venue-credit tail order

trigger: candidate is ranked or approved using Sharpe, win rate, profitable-time share, smooth returns or stop-loss-shaped P/L
action: retain those as descriptive metrics and add full return distribution, skew/tails, drawdown, expected shortfall, path liquidation, convexity, repeated-exposure survival and simple nonlinear benchmarks
risk_guard: no single smoothness, Sharpe, hit-rate or time-positive metric can approve an option strategy or leverage; agency incentives cannot override ruin limits

trigger: each valuation interval and after each hedge or roll
action: attribute P/L by leg, expiry and account; isolate fees, spread, funding, margin and unexplained residual
risk_guard: large or persistent residual triggers data/model/execution investigation and blocks new risk

trigger: every historical scan and backtest timestamp
action: persist full universe U_t, selected S_t, orders O_t, fills F_t, expired/delisted contracts, zero bids and data gaps
risk_guard: backtest is invalid if the source silently drops failed or unavailable candidates

trigger: single-underlying option candidates are combined across stocks, crypto assets, accounts or venues
action: build PortfolioMultiassetRiskSpec; stress PSD dependence, common jumps, liquidity/margin, custody/venue credit and account liquidation before final ranking
risk_guard: single-leg limited loss or long convexity does not prove portfolio survival; unavailable exotic hedges are excluded

trigger: a Pareto/power tail or alpha supports probability, stress or candidate ranking
action: populate PowerTailFitSpec with side, measure, horizon, crossover, alpha interval/profile, threshold trials, dependence, truncation, alternatives and out-of-sample exceedances
risk_guard: a log-log line, Table 2 value or point alpha cannot authorize price or risk limits

trigger: historical tail estimates are compared with option prices, risk-neutral density or expected payoff
action: populate TailMeasureBridgeSpec with P, Q, subjective and stress roles, numeraire, surface, risk-premium conversion, uncertainty and forward consistency
risk_guard: historical alpha and Table 2 market-move values cannot become Q density, fair value or true win rate

trigger: any long-tail or convexity candidate
action: compare executable premium and total carry against multi-model break-even payoff and simpler replication benchmark
risk_guard: reject tail exposure whose benefit disappears under plausible cost and probability intervals

trigger: a model, PDE, Monte Carlo or closed-form price/Greek is used for screening
action: attach PricingKernelPassport with process, measure, numeraire, payoff, boundaries, calibration, numerical tolerances, invariants and approved scope; reject known source negative fixtures
risk_guard: formula complexity or literature origin cannot bypass dimensional, forward, parity, boundary and independent-crosscheck tests

trigger: any simulation, probability, hedge-frequency result or model price is produced
action: attach StochasticProcessPassport with measure, numeraire, state, drift/carry, diffusion, jumps, vol/correlation processes, clocks, cutoff and omitted risks; identify fixture versus calibrated model
risk_guard: Brownian/GBM teaching paths cannot be presented as market truth; non-PSD generators are rejected

trigger: a payoff is a product, ratio, outperformance, exchange or cash-strike spread
action: route by exact payoff; include cross variation, numeraire/carry and settlement; reserve Margrabe label for exchange option
risk_guard: independent-Brownian formulas and generic spread labels are not universal

trigger: candidate or live position uses a similar asset, different venue or different expiry as hedge proxy
action: add proxy instrument, mapping, basis, correlation, fungibility, borrow/funding, liquidity and venue-isolation state variables to full revaluation
risk_guard: reject proxy sizing that fails correlation-break, basis-gap, borrow/convertibility loss, independent halt or venue-failure stress

trigger: high/low, Parkinson, Garman-Klass, barrier-hit, lookback, digital, stop distribution or gamma-frequency feature is used
action: populate RangeEstimatorSpec with exact session, venue/source, OHLC, bad-tick/trade-condition filters, halt/gap/missing-extreme policy, raw range, normalized Parkinson sigma and estimator assumptions
risk_guard: bad or missing extremes, session mismatch, closure/jump violation or unknown barrier observation rule disables the feature; normalized Parkinson sigma cannot use the printed 1.67-sigma trigger;…

trigger: every candidate snapshot and every declared spot-grid update
action: report analytic delta beside finite-range hedge and compute separate up/down gamma for every registered step
risk_guard: reject a single neutral or positive-Gamma label when range residuals or left/right signs conflict

trigger: a barrier pricing engine supports the source continuous no-skew benchmark
action: reproduce mirror spot, path counts, source node and table values; then test convergence, probability bounds, martingale, parity and monitoring limits
risk_guard: reflection results are not universal under jumps, local/stochastic vol, discrete monitoring, rebates or reverse barriers

trigger: a trade, roll, hedge, rebalance, venue exposure or tail risk is described as small or one-off
action: populate RepeatedExposureSpec with event, exposure/calendar clock, lambda, horizon, conditional hazards, dependence, survival curve, cumulative hazard and eventual-ruin condition
risk_guard: positive per-period probability alone does not imply certain ruin, while repeated non-summable hazard cannot be ignored; Figure 9 supplies no parameter

trigger: a model price or theoretical replication is used to rank or trade a candidate
action: populate executable hedge set, shortability/borrow, financing/collateral, observation grid, cost/impact, completeness and sub/super-hedge or executable price interval
risk_guard: an invisible or theoretical replicator cannot authorize an IBKR, Schwab, OKX or Binance order

trigger: a barrier terminates a claim while its underlying payoff is already materially in the money
action: populate ReverseBarrierContractSpec; scan sign regions and trigger discontinuity across spot, time, surface, carry and execution states
risk_guard: cheap premium and negative calendar decay do not imply positive edge; source parameters are incomplete

trigger: a low-frequency convex/tail strategy is evaluated under an assumption that it can always wait for its favorable event
action: populate CensoringAndPatienceSpec and simulate bleed, drawdown, margin, redemption, review, stop/restart, venue/custody and time-to-edge; report edge-before-stop and ruin probabilities
risk_guard: hindsight hold-to-crisis PnL excludes strategies and accounts that disappeared before the crisis

trigger: option horizon crosses overnight, weekend, holiday, market closure, session change, scheduled event or venue-specific downtime
action: report calendar, business and variance time; materialize session activity weights, scheduled-event jump budgets and source versions separately from baseline diffusion
risk_guard: do not hide event or weekend risk by changing IV without an auditable clock; no quarter-day or other literature convention becomes a current parameter without calibration

trigger: a candidate, alert or strategy report is emitted
action: emit one conditional decision sentence, one subject sentence, evidence refs, largest known risk, known unknowns and an action or no-trade route
risk_guard: do not compress a conditional grid result into an unconditional profit claim

trigger: portfolio, strategy or venue risk is ranked, hedged, rolled, reduced or approved
action: populate RiskPriorityState by current P/L-variance contribution, tail loss, liquidity/exit time, margin/liquidation urgency, observability and hedgeability; preserve market base risks and instrument residual risks as separate layers
risk_guard: historical primary/secondary labels and variance alone cannot set permanent priority; liquidity, liquidation and compound vol-of-vol/path risks can override ordinary Greek ordering

trigger: candidate return decomposition includes spread capture, maker rebate, queue priority or inventory-service income
action: declare execution role, quote obligation, maker/taker state, queue/cancel data, inventory P/L, realized spread and post-fill adverse move by horizon
risk_guard: ordinary API access or occasional passive fill cannot approve expected spread income; shock-state losses must be included

trigger: a vanilla option position rolls, harvests or rebuilds on first crossing of spot, IV, PnL or Greek thresholds
action: treat the rule as a strategy-level barrier; record first-hit distribution, trigger clock, gap-to-fill, repeated triggers, pre/intermediate/post legs, random holding time and account margin path
risk_guard: vanilla legal contracts do not make threshold execution path independent; backtests cannot fill at threshold or ignore recrossings

trigger: a vanilla strategy closes, harvests, rolls or rebuilds legs when spot, IV, PnL or a Greek first crosses a threshold
action: model the roll trigger as a stopping time with MonitoringScheduleSpec and GapDeltaState; record fake trigger, gap, recrossing, trigger-to-fill latency, partial fills, pre/intermediate/post risk tensor, random holding time and account cash/m…
risk_guard: dynamic management creates path dependence and discontinuity even when every listed leg is vanilla; backtests must not fill threshold orders at the threshold by assumption

trigger: a vanilla strategy rolls, harvests or rebuilds on a spot, IV, PnL or Greek threshold
action: reuse TriggerEvidenceSpec and OFF/ON/GAP reports; simulate pending, partial fill, bounce, recrossing, dispute-like feed correction and post-trigger total wealth
risk_guard: strategy-level thresholds create path and execution risk even without legal OTC barrier; no fill at threshold by assumption

trigger: any profit-taking, strike migration, expiry roll or replacement of an old option leg
action: snapshot pre/intermediate/post future-time by spot by surface by expiry by account tensors; report realized cash separately from close/open/legging costs and residual risks
risk_guard: net credit, current delta improvement or aggregate Greek neutrality cannot alone approve the roll; block if any partial-fill or account-liquidation branch is unresolved

trigger: eligible liquid chain with same expiry and declared ATM/wing strikes
action: construct long OTM put and call wings financed in part by fewer short ATM straddles; enumerate quantities rather than assume them
risk_guard: reject unbounded/over-budget shoulder loss, short-gamma margin failure or cost domination

trigger: any dynamically hedged or short-option candidate
action: simulate discrete hedging with jumps, spreads, slippage, fees, funding, liquidity gaps and margin/liquidation paths
risk_guard: delta hedging may not be represented as bounding loss; reject if any pre-registered path breaches survival limits

trigger: any multi-asset, dispersion, relative-value or supposedly diversified option portfolio
action: stress co-jumps, skew and volatility shifts, nonlinear tail dependence and simultaneous liquidity withdrawal
risk_guard: historical linear correlation alone earns no survival-critical diversification credit

trigger: before using variance, kurtosis, covariance or a moment-dependent estimator
action: declare the required moment order and compute maximum-to-sum concentration across sample sizes
risk_guard: do not present normal standard errors or moment optimization when required moments and convergence are not defensible

trigger: every scan over assets, strikes, expiries, filters or strategy parameters
action: persist the full trial family and use holdout, walk-forward and multiplicity-aware evaluation
risk_guard: no selected result may report a standalone p-value or performance statistic without total-search context

trigger: tail stress for any candidate where subexponential behavior remains plausible
action: include one-big-jump, clustered-extreme and beyond-historical-maximum scenarios
risk_guard: do not grant diversification or horizon-aggregation safety solely from a thin-tail model

trigger: any valuation, stress or sizing result using fitted volatility, jump, dependence or tail parameters
action: propagate parameter ranges and at least one declared meta-uncertainty layer through the payoff
risk_guard: reject candidates whose safety or edge depends on a single favorable point estimate

trigger: every forecast, candidate strategy and stress result
action: compute the exact terminal and path-dependent payoff under the declared measure and scenario set
risk_guard: a driver forecast may not bypass payoff, price, cost, margin or path-survival checks

trigger: quality-screened far-strike calls with a defensible common tail region and anchor
action: compute anchor-relative price envelopes over alpha, threshold, truncation and anchor choices
risk_guard: research-only; reject circular calibration-validation, stale/illiquid quotes and deviations that vanish after costs or parameter uncertainty

trigger: any backtest, estimator or Monte Carlo result used for approval
action: measure nested-sample, block and seed convergence and record a kappa-style diagnostic where applicable
risk_guard: mark the result inconclusive when tail-sensitive outputs do not stabilize over the declared sample range

trigger: every probability, likelihood, option-implied distribution and scenario weight
action: label the quantity as physical, pricing-implied, subjective or scenario weight and keep severity separate from event probability
risk_guard: never convert option prices to physical probabilities without an independently stated mapping and uncertainty

trigger: before extracting tail information or comparing option values across strikes
action: validate parity, monotonicity and convexity; retain native prices and IV coordinates; quantify finite-difference and smoothing uncertainty
risk_guard: reject chains whose violations exceed executable frictions or whose contract conventions are unresolved

trigger: barbell or tail-insurance candidate design
action: define a catastrophic-loss envelope first, then evaluate an auditable robust reserve plus bounded-risk convex sleeve against cash-only, underlying-only and conventional benchmarks
risk_guard: no universal allocation and no guaranteed-profit label; reject if reserve impairment, premium bleed, gaps, volatility repricing or liquidity can breach the declared envelope

trigger: candidate has multiple legs or an exact/limit decomposition
action: retain valuation, risk and execution component graphs separately; backtest portfolio-level netted management beside independently managed legs
risk_guard: do not label the sum of independently managed theoretical leg returns as executable portfolio return

trigger: a strategy or signal is discovered through literature, exploratory search, vendor/broker push, user request or preregistration
action: persist discovery channel, initial universe, filters, variants, stopped/missing results, vendor/publication filters and post-selection method; never silently upgrade pushed or published evidence
risk_guard: selection channel changes the base rate; illustrative close-to-100-percent claims are not universal priors

trigger: a cap/exploding/barrier payoff depends on intraday touch or official settlement
action: populate SettlementTriggerSpec and separate intraday-cross, official-fix, publication, revision and dispute states
risk_guard: similar terminal caps do not imply the same stopping time; source Figure 20.29 has a strike-label conflict

trigger: candidate passes sticky-vol spot stress or is described as long gamma/long convexity
action: revalue under registered joint spot-surface states and retain unknown states rather than interpolate them as facts
risk_guard: reject if survival depends on one sticky-vol convention or local vol convexity disappears over the stress range

trigger: strike, calendar, digital, barrier or multi-leg prices are compared or claimed to dominate
action: canonicalize contracts, prove statewise payoff relation, then test executable bid-ask, financing, credit, exercise, settlement, legging and margin before classifying an arbitrage
risk_guard: model-mid shape violations and prose rankings are not automatically executable; source put-butterfly text direction is rejected

trigger: evaluation of F1-F4
action: compare against no-trade, same-budget vanilla wing/straddle and a simple protected-underlying benchmark
risk_guard: reject added complexity unless it improves predeclared out-of-sample survival or net-convexity metrics after costs

trigger: a barrier replication is locally zeroed on today's skew or current barrier point
action: populate SkewBarrierState and revalue across spot-time-surface-carry-trigger states with theta, vega, volga, vanna and surface-jump residuals
risk_guard: zero residual today does not prove future or executable replication; carry can change Greek signs

trigger: candidate justification cites skew, fat tails, histogram or OTM crash protection
action: quarantine the source-printed skew formula, declare the production statistic separately, and simulate joint spot/surface/liquidity/correlation paths
risk_guard: terminal histogram or a nonstandard source statistic cannot alone approve a tail trade

trigger: source expression, label or worked example conflicts with adjacent prose, tables, dimensions, an algebraic invariant or an independently reproducible calculation
action: preserve original transcription and images, register the conflict, isolate it from production, and implement only an independently defined convention or explicit competing branches after review
risk_guard: never silently correct, normalize or operationalize an unresolved source anomaly; never treat nonnegative P/L as strictly positive; never reuse one symbol for raw and normalized statistics
unknowns: whether natural-language labels intended to include ties

trigger: stack or roll hedge weights use historical volatility/correlation or minimum variance
action: compare no hedge, simple stack, butterfly and constrained regularized min-var; retain p, H, Sigma, q and residual r; run out-of-sample, shrinkage, regime and cost branches
risk_guard: reject sample-only variance reduction, extreme/unstable weights, source-anomaly quantities or a solution that cannot trade as integers within depth/margin

trigger: multi-leg hedge or roll cannot be executed atomically and an emergency concentration hedge is proposed
action: enter EMERGENCY_STACK with explicit creation time, purpose, residual buckets, maximum TTL, fine-tune orders and unstack plan; snapshot pre/intermediate/post tensors
risk_guard: block a stack without TTL, residual report or executable unstack path; aggregate zero exposure is insufficient

trigger: any contract, complex structure, OTC-like payoff or multi-leg candidate enters research
action: materialize contract standard, two-sided market, quote width, executable depth, pricing reproducibility, system support, combo-order support and exit venues
risk_guard: unknown two-way exit, depth or model reproducibility forces CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED/WATCH_ONLY; theoretical decomposition cannot substitute for a tradable exit

trigger: a statistically significant pattern, spread, device bias or market-making-style edge is proposed for trading
action: require effect size, point-in-time holdout, executable bid/ask, costs, impact, funding, capacity, margin/liquidation and role-specific economic PnL; otherwise NO_TRADE
risk_guard: statistical detectability is not economic materiality or executable profit; ordinary users do not inherit maker spread

trigger: a direct, synthetic, embedded or rule-created payoff depends on first touch, breach, stop, take-profit, knockout, rebate, coupon cancellation or another path event before expiry
action: populate StoppingTimeContractSpec and MonitoringScheduleSpec; separate continuous model limit from actual observation source, equality, confirmation, payment timing, post-trigger state, cancellation and dispute rules;…
risk_guard: terminal payoff alone is insufficient; a price trigger is not a guaranteed fill and American binary is not vanilla American exercise

trigger: assumed alpha, Kelly, log utility, barbell or long-run growth is used to select position size
action: populate StrategyFunctionSustainabilitySpec; separate assumed measure/edge from wealth update and sizing; compare fractional log growth with liquidation wealth, ruin, open loss and model-error stress
risk_guard: log requires positive multiplicative wealth and is not a universal scalar objective; full Kelly or barbell labels cannot bypass survival and executable-price gates

trigger: any named option strategy, template, scan result, order ticket, backtest or roll event enters the system
action: store StrategyIdentity as a canonical ordered leg list with instrument identifier, side, quantity, multiplier, strike, expiry, style, settlement, account, venue and version; treat display names as non-authoritative aliases
risk_guard: strategy name, broker label or prose description cannot determine legs; leg mutation creates a new version and forces payoff, margin and lifecycle recomputation

trigger: every candidate and every rebalance event
action: compute pathwise per-account liquidation wealth before ranking return
risk_guard: reject if any pre-registered stress path crosses W_min or margin buffer

trigger: a risk-reversal or mirror-option package is proposed as a barrier hedge
action: populate SymmetryReplicationSpec; verify forward/numeraire, strike map, quantity, skew, carry, random duration, state-grid residual and trigger execution before ranking
risk_guard: the source calls the method questionable/pedagogical; it may not be labeled exact outside its assumptions

trigger: a variable is labelled fat-tailed, power law, subexponential, bounded, Gaussian or non-Gaussian
action: populate multi-label TailClassPassport with support, side, transform, measure/horizon, exponent convention, moments, mgf, class statuses, threshold diagnostics, dependence and alternatives
risk_guard: overlapping classes are not an ordinal ladder; no positive mgf does not imply subexponential; left tail requires a nonnegative loss transform

trigger: a probability, volatility, correlation, VaR, tail frequency or expected payoff enters screening
action: populate TailEnvironmentSpec with variable/transform, side, P/Q/subjective/stress, horizon/clock, dependence, jumps, increment bounds, regimes and candidate families
risk_guard: no estimator or distribution is accepted before its event environment and payoff magnitude role are declared

trigger: a fitted distribution or generator is presented as the tail model
action: build TailModelEnsembleSpec across Pareto/truncated/lognormal/t/tempered/mixture/jump-regime alternatives; report fit, holdout, price/PnL/margin ranges and ranking stability
risk_guard: finite data identify a compatible set, not a unique generator; source 1.7-to-2.4 is not a universal correction

trigger: Ch.15-16 numeric examples or table values are used as fixtures
action: recompute tail ratios, stake variance, exceedance and top-share; preserve trillion, penny-unit and alpha=1 conflicts as explicit failures
risk_guard: never silently repair the source or promote illustrative historical numbers to production parameters

trigger: a historical maximum, modeled truncation, price domain or venue rule is used as a maximum shock/loss
action: populate UpperBoundStatus; distinguish legal/physical/model/observed/unknown, run increasing cap ladder and report asymptotic exposure, margin absorption and ranking sensitivity
risk_guard: observed max is not a hard cap, while unknown cap does not make every bounded payoff mathematically infinite

trigger: any theta-based rank, carry claim or holding-period P/L explanation
action: show raw theta, each versioned modified-theta branch, funding, borrow, fees and path P/L separately
risk_guard: positive theta cannot approve a short-option trade and funding cannot be hidden inside theta

trigger: backtest, parameter search, strategy comparison or manager/algorithm track record is evaluated
action: retain all attempted assets, windows, parameters, seeds, failures and stopped runs; report effective independent sample size, dependence, costs, capacity and multiple-testing diagnostics
risk_guard: selected-winner results, nominal trade count or higher frequency cannot establish edge; nonnegative outcomes cannot be labelled strict profits

trigger: every parameter, model, universe or rule change
action: create immutable trial ID and retain failed/abandoned versions; predeclare train/validation/holdout windows
risk_guard: no result may be labeled out-of-sample after tuning on its evaluation period

trigger: barrier validity depends on trades, quotes, independent sources or a fixing in a thin market
action: record TriggerEvidenceSpec; stress defend/trigger attempt, bad tick, venue split, halt/auction, feed lag and valid/invalid alternative histories
risk_guard: model hit is not legal hit and historical cases are not current manipulation probabilities or accusations

trigger: a claim or strategy state changes when a barrier/threshold is hit
action: estimate hit-time, overshoot, latency, book-depth, impact and partial-fill distributions; deduct conditional unwind reserve and run fake-trigger/gap/recrossing/halt branches
risk_guard: trigger price is never assumed to be a fill and claim Greeks reaching zero do not close the hedge

trigger: candidate rationale mentions cheap/expensive value, hold-to-expiry, flow, demand, resale or expected future buyer
action: declare thesis_family terminal_value/flow_resale/hybrid, holding horizon, exit event/counterparty, inventory limit, failure branch and any predeclared switch rule
risk_guard: block ex-post thesis switching; terminal-value candidates need cost-after-path expectation, while flow/resale candidates need observable flow and failed-resale stress

trigger: VaR, sigma loss, confidence level or diversification number is shown
action: label VaR as a one-sided linear short-horizon benchmark with sampling and linearization error; display full-revaluation stress, liquidity, margin and liquidation wealth beside it
risk_guard: VaR is not maximum loss, expected shortfall, ruin probability or a sufficient derivative risk measure

trigger: multi-scale volatility, tick mean reversion, negative autocorrelation or variance ratio is used as an entry, hedge-frequency or market-making signal
action: compute synchronized mid/last/bid/ask/microprice variants with overlap and heteroskedasticity-robust inference; model bid-ask bounce, stale quotes, queue/nonfill, fees, impact and adverse selection; report gross and executable net signal
risk_guard: last/tick-only reversal, historical figures, ordinary passive fills or gross variance difference cannot establish alpha; block when expected move is not larger than executable costs and shock-state inventory risk

trigger: any realized, historical, implied, forecast, stress, absolute, tick, range or annualized volatility enters a feature, comparison, alert or strategy rule
action: attach measure role, price/return unit, source, clock, window, centering, weights, annualization basis, overlap, effective sample size, data-quality flags, uncertainty and as-of timestamp
risk_guard: missing estimator identity forces ESTIMATOR_UNRESOLVED; actual, implied, forecast, pricing input and stress cannot overwrite one field; RMS cannot be labelled sample SD
